svg.data-weight: 16.42 lb (7.45 kg) with no power supply and no fan module (guide Table 10)
svg.data-depth-no-psu: 467.0 mm (18.39 in, 46.7 cm) with no power supply or uplink module (Table 10)
svg.data-depth-with-uplink: 509.6 mm (20.06 in, 50.96 cm) with a power supply and an uplink module (Table 10)
svg.data-uplink-module-weight: 0.57 lb (0.26 kg) for the 2-port EX-UM-2QSFP-MR and for the 4-port EX-UM-4SFPP-MR
svg.data-airflow-cfm: fan 22 CFM, each power supply 7.5 CFM; 59 CFM total with two supplies (datasheet, stated for the line)
svg.data-poe-budget: 1030 W available with one 1400 W supply (guide Table 35); the datasheet gives 1100 W
svg.data-psu-redundancy: N+0 or N+N; up to two supplies, one is enough for the chassis
svg.data-acoustic-noise: 53.7 dBA with a 1400 W AC AFO supply (datasheet Table 3, ISO 7779 at 23 C)
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 45 C (32 to 113 F) for AFO models
svg.data-humidity: 10 to 85 percent noncondensing operating; 0 to 95 percent non-operating
svg.data-altitude: up to 3049 m operating (10,000 ft); 4877 m non-operating
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 10 members; the four rear QSFP+ ports are dedicated Virtual Chassis ports and cannot be network ports; joins an EX4300 Virtual Chassis only through a 40-Gigabit port of the other members, and must take the primary role there
svg.data-poe: all 48 ports up to 95 W, the datasheet's pre-standard IEEE 802.3bt PoE++
svg.data-macsec: IEEE 802.1AE MACsec AES256 on all access and uplink ports
svg.data-uplink-module: one slot; 2-port 40-Gigabit QSFP+ / 100-Gigabit QSFP28 EX-UM-2QSFP-MR or 4-port 1/10-Gigabit SFP+ EX-UM-4SFPP-MR (neither is part of the shipping configuration)
svg.data-optics-qsfp: 40GbE QSFP+ SR4 (multimode) and DAC direct-attach copper (datasheet, Supported Optics)
svg.data-console: mini-USB on the front, RJ-45 CON on the rear
svg.data-oob: MGMT RJ-45 with link activity and status lamps (rear)
svg.data-usb: one USB port on the rear
svg.data-reset: pinhole Reset button on the rear
svg.data-nebs: GR-1089-CORE EMC and electrical safety for network telecommunications equipment (listed by the datasheet; no level stated)
svg.data-emc: FCC 47 CFR Part 15 Class A, EN 55022 Class A, ICES-003 Class A, VCCI Class A, AS/NZS CISPR 22 Class A, CISPR 22 Class A, EN 55024, EN 300386, CE
